en.title: Inspect a named message
en.statement: Inspect the complete program that binds a string to message and prints the stored value. Identify the name and its value separately in each labeled step, then run the unchanged example.
hints: Find the statement that first binds message.
The text on its right is the value; message is its identifier.
Read the unquoted message in the output statement as retrieve its stored value.
